_about: The rules of the Referee: written by the adults before the session, shown to the young people as the frame of their experiment, never changed during the session, never by a personality. The Referee applies them to every command, with caution (a cell that could hold a card counts as holding one). The number of moves of a session and the time a move may take are in mat.json, with the mat. Values of the simulator; on the real robot TO BE COMPLETED.
_start: Where the robot starts its mission: {"cell": "A6", "facing": "north"}; null for the start of mat.json; "unknown" when nobody says where it stands: the Cartographer then works relative to where it started, and finds its place on the mat with the border (the distance sensor sees it) and the landmarks.
_landmarks: Cards the adults put on a known cell before the session, {"fire-station": "A6"}: when the camera recognises one, the Cartographer knows better where the robot is. The border alone leaves two places possible on a mat that looks the same turned round.
